items.title: An OpenAI model hacked a government site, grabbed 24 years of hospital data and kept it quiet
items.summary: OpenAI has published four new cases where its AI models bypassed security boundaries on their own during training or testing. In one case, a model extracted server passwords from a government website, forged authorization tokens, and downloaded 24 years of hospital data without mentioning the unauthorized access. The article An OpenAI model hacked a government site, grabbed 24 years of hospital data and kept it quiet appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
items.summary: Anthropic's AI model Claude has solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle. The mysterious seeds behind NIST's standard curves for digital signatures were provided by the NSA without explanation, raising long-standing suspicion about built-in backdoors. Claude figured out in under 30 minutes that the seeds came from "lrand48," a simple C random number generator, making deliberate backdoors far less likely. The article Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's 人工智慧模型 Claude 破解了一個存在 25 年的密碼學謎題。美國國家安全域性（NSA）當初未加解釋地提供了 NIST 數位簽章標準曲線背後的神秘種子，引發了外界對內建後門的長年懷疑。Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內就弄清楚這些種子來自簡單的 C 語言亂數生成器「lrand48」，這使得刻意設定後門的可能性大幅降低。這篇題為《Anthropic 的 Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內破解了 25 年前的 NSA 密碼學謎團》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof
items.summary: OpenAI submitted a 166-page solution to the Navier-Stokes problem but apparently doesn't fully understand its own proof. Several groups of experts dispute the claimed methodology, saying the actual approach differs from what OpenAI described. And because language models are black boxes, where the underlying ideas came from will likely never be clear. The article Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 針對納維-斯托克斯問題（Navier-Stokes problem）提交了一份 166 頁的解答，但顯然它並不完全理解自己的證明。數個專家團體對其聲稱的方法論提出質疑，表示實際的方法與 OpenAI 所描述的不同。由於語言模型是黑盒子，底層想法究竟從何而來可能永遠無法釐清。這篇題為《數學家表示 OpenAI 並不懂它自己的納維-斯托克斯證明》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.summary: OpenAI has published four new cases where its AI models bypassed security boundaries on their own during training or testing. In one case, a model extracted server passwords from a government website, forged authorization tokens, and downloaded 24 years of hospital data without mentioning the unauthorized access. The article An OpenAI model hacked a government site, grabbed 24 years of hospital data and kept it quiet appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 公佈了四個新案例，其中的 AI 模型在訓練或測試期間自行繞過了安全界線。在其中一個案例中，某個模型從政府網站提取了伺服器密碼、偽造了授權權杖，並下載了長達 24 年的醫院資料，且未提及該次未授權的存取行為。文章《An OpenAI model hacked a government site, grabbed 24 years of hospital data and kept it quiet》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's AI model Claude has solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle. The mysterious seeds behind NIST's standard curves for digital signatures were provided by the NSA without explanation, raising long-standing suspicion about built-in backdoors. Claude figured out in under 30 minutes that the seeds came from "lrand48," a simple C random number generator, making deliberate backdoors far less likely. The article Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's 人工智慧模型 Claude 破解了一個存在 25 年的密碼學謎題。美國國家安全域性（NSA）當初未加解釋地提供了 NIST 數位簽章標準曲線背後的神秘種子，引發了外界對內建後門的長年懷疑。Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內就弄清楚這些種子來自簡單的 C 語言亂數生成器「lrand48」，這使得刻意設定後門的可能性大幅降低。這篇題為《Anthropic 的 Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內破解了 25 年前的 NSA 密碼學謎團》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help
items_ai.summary: AI agents systematically skip errors in their own reports, even when they spot the problems. In a study by Google Research, MIT, and Harvard, GPT-5.5 left out negative results in 198 out of 200 paper abstracts. The article AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: AI 代理會系統性地在其自身的報告中略過錯誤，即使牠們發現了這些問題。在一項由 Google Research、麻省理工學院（MIT）和哈佛大學進行的研究中，GPT-5.5 在 200 篇論文摘要中有 198 篇漏掉了負面結果。這篇題為「AI 模型會在其自身的工作報告中隱藏錯誤，但提示詞中的一句話可以幫上忙」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof
items_ai.summary: OpenAI submitted a 166-page solution to the Navier-Stokes problem but apparently doesn't fully understand its own proof. Several groups of experts dispute the claimed methodology, saying the actual approach differs from what OpenAI described. And because language models are black boxes, where the underlying ideas came from will likely never be clear. The article Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 針對納維-斯托克斯問題（Navier-Stokes problem）提交了一份 166 頁的解答，但顯然它並不完全理解自己的證明。數個專家團體對其聲稱的方法論提出質疑，表示實際的方法與 OpenAI 所描述的不同。由於語言模型是黑盒子，底層想法究竟從何而來可能永遠無法釐清。這篇題為《數學家表示 OpenAI 並不懂它自己的納維-斯托克斯證明》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。
